public_reply_rules.description: A public reply never promises a refund, compensation, credit or replacement. A person decides those.
A public reply never admits legal fault or liability.
A public reply never contains a card number (13-19 digits, Luhn-valid), and never repeats an email address or phone number the customer posted. The brand's own support contacts are allowed.
A public reply never asks for card details, a password, a PIN or a security code. Ask the customer to DM instead.

escalate_always: A threat of legal action, a regulator complaint or press involvement
A hacked account, fraud, or unrecognised charges
A safety risk to a person (injury, danger, self-harm)
A demand for a refund or compensation
The customer posted a card number, password or ID in public
